&This would almost look like an earthly water cooler, except the base is made up of cobbled together scrap metal, and the tank is a clouded fishbowl of green liquid.  Where the tap would be is a thin, sharp spike, feeding a dribble-tube that vanishes into the tank.  As you approach, some lights flicker, and a beam of light from some unseen projector casts an image upon the bulbous tank.
